products.title: Andy Cotton Hoodie | West Virginia
products.body_html:
With quilted texture and a classic hoodie silhouette, our best-selling Andy sweatshirt will elevate your on and off-duty style. Made from our signature long-staple organic Peruvian Pima cotton with comfortable stretch, it gets better, softer and perfectly broken-in the more you wear it.

  • 58% Peruvian Pima cotton, 32% polyester, 10% nylon

products.title: Everyday Jacket | West Virginia
products.body_html:
Based on the best-selling Everyday Vest, the Everyday Jacket is just that: An essential for your every day. ● Chest pocket

● Welt pockets at each side

products.title: The Paige | West Virginia

products.title: Cool Hand Luke Polo | West Virginia
products.body_html:
Stay cool and dry all day long in this lightweight long sleeve. It’s made with a blended nylon stretch knit fabric, and features a slightly textured surface that keeps fresh air flowing through. products.title: Gibson Striped  Cotton Polo | West Virginia

products.body_html:

  • Partial ribbed cuffs; vented hem

  • Hand warmer pockets

  • Machine wash

  • Imported
